patterns.message: pi-cloudpid runs on the owner's machine and must not import Workers code (docs/architecture/mcp-endpoint.md → The `/cloudpid` command).
pi-cloudpid must not import alchemy (docs/architecture/mcp-endpoint.md → The `/cloudpid` command).
pi-cloudpid must not import pi-durable: it is the Workers side of cloudpid (docs/architecture/mcp-endpoint.md → The `/cloudpid` command).
pi-cloudpid must not import @cloudpid/extensions (docs/architecture/mcp-endpoint.md → The `/cloudpid` command).
pi-cloudpid must not import workerd (docs/architecture/mcp-endpoint.md → The `/cloudpid` command).
pi-cloudpid bundles the SDK's client and nothing else of it: not the server, core, an extension or a transport (docs/architecture/mcp-endpoint.md → The `/cloudpid` command).

pi-cloudpid imports only types from @cloudpid/protocol (`import type`): its Schemas pull effect and the Registry into the bundle, so the constants are copied (src/constants.ts, checked by constants.test.ts).
